title: Chat Interface
content: Build real-time chat/messaging interface. Layout: flex-col h-full with header, messages area (flex-1 overflow-y-auto), input area. Header: recipient avatar and name, online status, call/video icons. Messages: grouped by date. Message bubbles: own messages right-aligned (bg-blue-600 text-white), others left-aligned (bg-gray-100). Typing indicator: animated dots. Input area: text input, attachment button, emoji button, send button.

variants.simple: Create messaging interface with message bubbles and input field.
variants.detailed: Build real-time chat/messaging interface. Layout: flex-col h-full with header, messages area (flex-1 overflow-y-auto), input area. Header: recipient avatar and name, online status, call/video icons. Messages: grouped by date. Message bubbles: own messages right-aligned (bg-blue-600 text-white), others left-aligned (bg-gray-100). Typing indicator: animated dots. Input area: text input, attachment button, emoji button, send button.
variants.advanced: Build real-time chat/messaging interface with full features. Layout: flex flex-col h-full (typically h-screen or fixed height container). Header: flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b. Header left: back arrow (mobile), recipient avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), name (font-medium), online status indicator (green dot + "Online" or "Last seen 2h ago"). Header right: call (Phone icon), video (Video icon), more menu (info, mute, block). Messages area: flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-2, flex flex-col. Date separators: sticky text-xs text-gray-500 text-center py-2 ("Today", "Yesterday", "Jan 15"). Message bubbles: own messages (ml-auto bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-br-md max-w-[75%] px-4 py-2), others (mr-auto bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md). Consecutive same-sender: reduce spacing, hide avatar. Bubble content: message text (whitespace-pre-wrap), optional image/file attachments with thumbnail (click to expand), timestamp below in text-xs text-gray-400 (own) or text-gray-500. Typing indicator: three animated dots (animate-pulse or bounce) in bubble shape when other user is typing. Read receipts: checkmarks after message (single check = sent, double check = delivered, blue double check = read). Input area: flex items-end gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-t bg-white. Attachment button: Paperclip icon, opens file picker or bottom sheet with options (photo, file, location). Emoji button: Smile icon, opens emoji picker popover. Text input: flex-1 rounded-full border px-4 py-2, auto-resize textarea for multiline, placeholder "Type a message...". Send button: Send icon (or arrow), bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-full p-2, disabled when input empty. Send behavior: Enter sends (configurable), Shift+Enter for newline. Scroll behavior: auto-scroll to bottom on new message, show "Scroll to bottom" floating button when scrolled up. Message states: sending (opacity-70), sent (normal), failed (red warning with "Tap to retry"). Image messages: thumbnail with aspect ratio preserved, click opens lightbox. Link previews: unfurled inline. Reactions: long-press message to add emoji reaction. Real-time: WebSocket connection, messages appear instantly. Accessibility: messages in list, announce new messages.

author: Ersin KOÇ
